question: Which machine was the very first wheeled robot ever driven on Mars?
funFact: Sojourner in 1997 was the first wheeled vehicle on Mars! It was only about the size of a kitchen microwave oven.

question: What did Apollo 17 astronauts use to repair their broken lunar buggy fender?
options: Gray duct tape and lunar maps
A spare metal tire from Earth
They left it broken and walked
funFact: Astronauts Gene Cernan and Jack Schmitt taped 4 paper lunar maps together with heavy-duty gray duct tape to keep the blinding lunar dust from blowing in their faces!

question: Why did the Spirit rover accidentally discover proof of ancient water on Mars?
options: It used a laser cannon to blast a crater
Its broken front wheel dragged in the dirt and scraped up white silica
It fell into an underground frozen lake
Astronauts told it where to dig
funFact: When Spirit's right-front wheel jammed, engineers dragged it backwards. The stuck wheel acted like a plow and unearthed bright white silica, which only forms in bubbling hot springs!

question: What historic relic from Earth is hidden underneath the Ingenuity Mars helicopter?
options: A tiny piece of fabric from the Wright Brothers' 1903 airplane
A guitar pick from a famous musician
A leaf from an apple tree
funFact: NASA taped a postage-stamp-sized piece of muslin fabric from the wing of the 1903 Wright Flyer underneath Ingenuity, connecting Earth's first airplane to the first flight on another world!
